Subject: PO GF-4319 — invoice generation & VAT evidence

Hi Ava,

Thanks — attaching PO GF-4319 for the upcoming monthly bill. Can Redwood issue the invoice for this PO? We prefer the invoice be pushed into our AP portal (Acme Portal ID: ACME-7021) but we need an email copy to accounts-payable@acme.com as well. Also please include our VAT certificate and the customer reference GF-4319 on the invoice.

A few asks from AP:
- Invoice PDF and XML (if available) for routing to our system.
- VAT proof attached to the invoice package (PDF).
- Bank remittance instructions on the invoice (SEPA preferred).

Attached: PO_GF-4319.pdf

Can you confirm who will create the invoice (Redwood or do you want us to ingest a stub)? Timing: we need invoice issued by end of month (31 Aug) to meet our close.

Thanks,

- We will include the VAT certificate and the PO reference on the invoice.

Ava / Kimberly — I recommend Redwood be the invoice originator here. Operational notes:
- Deliver both PDF and a simple invoice XML (our billing engine exports a minimal schema) to the portal; send PDF copy to accounts-payable@acme.com.
- Attach VAT_Certificate_Acme_2028.pdf as part of the package — AP often wants a separate PDF in the upload.
- Include GL mapping line: Product code RD-INF-03 -> GL 401210 (we'll include a mapping table in the invoice metadata).
- Remittance: SEPA preferred — IBAN: NL91RBOS0123456789 (Redwood Treasury); include BIC: RBOSNL2A; also include wire fallback.

If Acme cannot accept XML, portal SFTP drop of a ZIP (invoice.pdf + invoice.xml + vat_certificate.pdf) works fine. Kimberly, can you prepare the ZIP schema and a provisional invoice file for approval?

Ben Carter
Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

- If they support Peppol, we can emit CII XML — confirm before we commit.
- I will generate a provisional invoice: Invoice_20280815-Redwood-000123.pdf (stub) and the companion XML following our "minimal-billing-v1" schema. Once Ava confirms content, I will sign and schedule the portal push.
- VAT: include VAT_Certificate_Acme_2028.pdf as separate attachment inside the ZIP for SFTP or as a separate upload for portal.

- Ava: confirm we should proceed as Redwood-originated invoice.

Hi Sara — thanks for the quick responses. Confirming next steps so we can close the loop: 

1) Redwood will be the invoice originator and will issue by 2028-08-31.
2) Delivery: we will push the invoice package into Acme's portal. Sara confirmed SFTP delivery (sftp://invoices.acme.com/drop/incoming/) and provided a short-lived test credential by separate message. We will also send an email copy to accounts-payable@acme.com.
3) Format: PDF + minimal XML (attached inside ZIP), plus VAT certificate as separate PDF inside the ZIP.
4) Remittance: SEPA preferred. We'll include IBAN and BIC in the payment block per Ben's note.

Attached to this thread: provisional invoice stub (Invoice_20280815-Redwood-000123.pdf) and VAT file (VAT_Certificate_Acme_2028.pdf). Once Sara confirms the SFTP path and test credentials are good, Kimberly will schedule the push and Ben will confirm GL mapping.
